description: Classification overlay for the bundles under packs/ (ADR-004, ADR-005). Each bundle has one domain; a provider inherits its bundle's domain unless it names its own. Each provider names one or more record shapes, the subdomains of its domain it covers, and any number of themes. A subdomain no provider covers is a coverage gap. Nothing here changes runtime behaviour, bundle ids or provider ids.
